title: Profile makeover
when: Your profiles do not say who you help or why to follow.
summary: Audit each profile, write one positioning line, rewrite everywhere, choose pinned content.

steps.title: Audit every profile
steps.do: Score each profile out of 100 and list what lost points.

steps.title: Write the positioning line
steps.do: One sentence: who you help, how, and why you. Under 15 words.

steps.title: Rewrite name, bio, link
steps.do: Fix in order of points recovered. Keep search terms in the name field.

steps.title: Choose pinned content
steps.do: Three pieces that show what the account is about. Make them if you have none.

steps.title: Re-audit
steps.do: Score again. Anything under 70 gets a second pass.
